long_texts.text: The Panama Canal opened in 1914 and connects the Atlantic and Pacific oceans. It was handed over to Panama at the end of 1999. Today the canal is widely considered the most impressive engineering project of the twentieth century. Ships pay tolls to use it, and traffic is expected to double by 2040.
